column1: # License texts build.ps1 downloads at build time into LICENSES/<component>/<file> (Install-UpstreamLicenses in
# build-helpers.ps1). None of them is committed: each is fetched from the pinned upstream source below and the build
# fails unless its SHA-256 matches. SOURCES.md says why each source and version was chosen.
#   component  version  file  sha256  url  [source-sha256  extract]
#   sha256         of the file written to LICENSES/<component>/<file>
#   url            the download: GitHub raw at a tag or commit, a nupkg from api.nuget.org, or a release zip
#   source-sha256  of the download, when the file is extracted from it (otherwise the download is the file)
#   extract        zip:<entry>         the entry of that name in the zip / nupkg
#                  lines:<first>-<last> those lines, byte for byte, of the downloaded text (a license header)
# Every version is the one Squirrel.Windows pins (src/*/*.csproj, src/*/packages.config, the vendor/nuget submodule,
# src/Setup/wtl90). Re-pin together with $SquirrelVersion in build.ps1: re-check the versions, update the URLs and
# SHA-256s (curl -fsSL <url> | sha256sum) and the line below. The build fails while they differ.
